description:
pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:494 — DeviationScope::issuer_dn_contains stores the substring verbatim. Lowercasing happens in DeviationStore::add (per commit 607b38b1 "fix(pkix-lint): Unicode-aware case folding in issuer_dn_contains" and the related PKIX-7f92.21 follow-up issue).

The constructor doc says:
  /// Pre-lowercase the substring or rely on DeviationStore::add to do so at insertion time

CALLER FOOTGUN: A caller who constructs a scope and calls matches() directly — without going through DeviationStore::add — silently never matches on mixed-case input:

  let scope = DeviationScope::issuer_dn_contains("Müller AG");
  let m = scope.matches(&cert, now_unix);  // returns false even if cert's
                                            // issuer DN has "Müller AG"
                                            // (the cert's stringification
                                            // is also lowercased by the
                                            // matches() implementation,
                                            // making the case mismatch silent)

The standard use case is via DeviationStore::add, which case-folds in flight. But:
- Ad-hoc filtering code outside the store path silently breaks.
- Unit tests that construct scopes directly fail-closed without explanation.
- A future contributor mistakenly using DeviationScope::matches() for some non-store purpose gets silent wrong answers.

The fix is at the constructor:

REMEDIATION:

1. NORMALIZE AT CONSTRUCTION:
   pub fn issuer_dn_contains(substring: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
       let s = substring.into();
       let folded = case_fold(&s);  // existing implementation in store::add
       Self::from_props(
           SCOPE_KIND_ISSUER_DN_CONTAINS,
           vec![(PROP_SUBSTRING, ScopePropValue::String(folded))],
       )
   }

   - Constructor cost matches store::add's current cost. No new perf hit.
   - Scope.matches() works correctly without store::add.
   - DeviationStore::add can keep its current double-fold (idempotent) or drop the in-flight fold (constructor already did it).

2. MAKE THE TYPE SYSTEM ENFORCE THE NORMALIZATION:
   Introduce a NormalizedSubstring(String) newtype that always holds a case-folded value. Constructors return it; matches takes it. Caller-friendly via a public constructor.

3. DOCUMENT THE PRECONDITION AS BLOCKING:
   "DeviationScope::matches() requires the scope to have been inserted into a DeviationStore via add(); calling matches() on a bare-constructed scope produces undefined-but-safe behavior."

   Documentation-only; preserves the footgun but explains it.

Option 1 is the cleanest fix. The constructor doc already says "Pre-lowercase the substring or rely on DeviationStore::add" — moving the normalization into the constructor makes the choice unconditional.

Pre-1.0 free.

RELATED: PKIX-7f92.10 (issuer_dn_contains matches Name::to_string output, not RDN values) — different concern, but in the same constructor. Together they suggest a full audit of the issuer_dn_contains semantic contract before 1.0.
title: DeviationScope::issuer_dn_contains lowercase normalization only happens inside DeviationStore::add; bare-scope DeviationScope::matches silently fails on uppercased input the operator wrote
